messages:
DeployBot: Production deploy started -> env: prod, tag: v3.6.2, commit: `9a1b2c3d`. Owner: @alice. Change window: 2026-03-20 02:00-03:30 UTC. Canary: 10% for 15m. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/prod-deploys/v3.6.2

alice: Kicking off rollout now. Notifying on-call and PG leads.

ben: Can we confirm that the quantized model profile is pinned for this tag?

carol: Confirmed — model-serving pin in infra is at `model:v3.6.2-q8`. I pushed the ACL for rollout.

DeployBot: Canary promoted to 10% at 02:10 UTC. Observability checks running (latency, errors, tail-latency).

sre-bot: Canary health: latency +1ms, error rate 0.09% (baseline 0.1%). No CPU/GPU throttles. :white_check_mark:

dave: Seeing a small spike in KV cache misses on shard-gpu-12 around 02:12. digging into logs now.

alice: Hold at 10% while we validate the cache behavior.

dave: Update: false-positive from a health-proxy metric aggregator. No impact to inference latency. Metric stream cleared. Recommend proceed. :thumbsup:

alice: Proceeding to 25% at 02:16 UTC.

DeployBot: Traffic moved to 25%. Canary window extended 10m as precaution.

ben: Running quick smoke across reranking and streaming endpoints. Sending results in a min.

ben: Smoke OK — streaming stable, no excess retries.

alice: Rolling to 100% now.

DeployBot: Traffic moved to 100% at 02:25 UTC. Post-deploy checks running (slo-check, traces, error-budget).

sre-bot: Post-deploy checks green. 5m aggregation: latency within SLA, error rate unchanged, token throughput normal. :white_check_mark:

DeployBot: Prod deploy complete -> tag: v3.6.2, commit: `9a1b2c3d`. Total duration: 18m. Release notes: https://docs.internal/releases/v3.6.2. Change window closed.

alice: Thanks everyone — will follow up with a short post-deploy note in #eng-releases and update the rollout checklist.

carol: I'll schedule the canary telemetry baseline diff for tomorrow's digest.

ben: LGTM.

dave: Good to close.

DeployBot: Pinned runtime snapshot: `runtime-20260320-9a1b2c3d`. If any regressions pop up, run rollback: `deploy rollback --tag=v3.6.1` and notify #incidents.
